title: Dialog
description: Fiori modal dialog with header/footer bars and Negative/Critical/Positive/Information states (ui5-dialog).

usage.summary: Pause the current task for a focused decision, confirmation or contained editing task.
useWhen: Ask users to confirm an action or supply input before returning to the main screen.
Keep a contained editing task in a modal window when the surrounding page must remain blocked.
Use state="negative" or "critical" for an alert dialog that needs immediate attention.

avoidWhen.when: Show contextual content beside an opener. Use ResponsivePopover for a full-screen surface on phones.
Offer a hierarchy of commands without a form or confirmation task.
Confirm a completed action transiently without requiring a response.
Keep a contextual message visible alongside otherwise usable page content.
Ask for a short confirmation or report an outcome with standard actions.
